kfbe01.title: Aries arrives 40 minutes early
kfbe01.caption:
The date is at 8. Aries has been there since 7:20, talking at double speed and already planning date 2.
Who do you know that shows up this early?

kfbe02.title: Taurus judges the date by the bread
kfbe02.caption:
Taurus gave the bread a 10/10 before the date even sat down. Then came the real test: the last bite.
What is your food dealbreaker?

kfbe03.title: Gemini tells a story inside a story
kfbe03.caption:
One story became a cousin, a bakery and space. The date added a fourth topic and Gemini fell a little bit in love.
Tag your favourite tangent person.

kfbe04.title: Cancer is already picturing the holidays
kfbe04.caption:
Four minutes in and Cancer is hanging two stockings in its head. Mum got mentioned, the receipt got kept.
Too soon, or right on time?

kfbe05.title: Leo gets a compliment back
kfbe05.caption:
Leo brought a 40-slide show about Leo. One sweet sentence from the date and the room went quiet.
What is the compliment that would get you?

kfbe06.title: Virgo made a bingo card about the date
kfbe06.caption:
Virgo came with its own clipboard to grade the date. The host's card was grading Virgo the whole time.
Who needs to put the clipboard down?

kfbe07.title: Libra says "I don't mind, you pick"
kfbe07.caption:
Round three of menus, a server asleep standing up, and then Libra finally said the word: pasta.
How many rounds of you-pick do you usually last?

kfbe08.title: Scorpio asks the deep question first
kfbe08.caption:
Menus closed, eye contact at 11/10, and the first question was about fears. The date answered for real and asked one back.
Deep first, or small talk first?

kfbe09.title: Sagittarius wants a second location
kfbe09.caption:
Sag had a backpack on and one foot out the door before the bread arrived. Then the date said four words: I like it here.
Which sign is always ready to leave?

kfbe10.title: Capricorn runs the date like a meeting
kfbe10.caption:
Agenda on the table, Q3 recap, the bill split to the cent. One question about fun and the phone went face down.
Who do you know that schedules feelings?

kfbe11.title: Aquarius asks the weird question
kfbe11.caption:
One giant duck or ten tiny dogs, as pets. Aquarius asked it on a first date and got a real answer with tiny jobs.
Duck or dogs? Go.

kfbe12.title: Pisces goes on a first date
kfbe12.caption:
The host left the booth to go on a date and cried at the menu, the candle and the kindness. The date cried too.
Who else cries at the nice parts?

kfbe13.title: Green flag bingo
kfbe13.caption:
Nobody plays this card: follow-up questions, kindness to the server, laughing at a moon pun, a text that says home safe.
What is your favourite quiet green flag?

kfbe14.title: Nervous bingo
kfbe14.caption:
Waved at the wrong person, said you too to the server, forgot a name for one whole second. Then the date admitted it too.
Which square have you hit?

kfbe15.title: Video call first date
kfbe15.caption:
Frozen mid-laugh, you are on mute, a cat on the keyboard and one bar of signal. They laughed through all of it.
Video first date: yes or no?

kfbe16.title: The whole dinner: Taurus x Virgo
kfbe16.caption:
A whole first date on one card: a trip on the step, the ex question, one spoon for dessert and a goodbye we waited for.
Which square made you smile?

kfbe17.title: Mini golf: Gemini x Capricorn
kfbe17.caption:
Nine holes, one windmill that hated them, a fake miss that got caught, and the first time Capricorn laughed out loud.
Who is your mini golf rival?

kfbe18.title: The museum date: Scorpio x Sagittarius
kfbe18.caption:
Sag read every sign out loud and Scorpio found the saddest painting. The best part was the bench at the end, when nobody talked.
Who do you like being quiet with?

kfbe19.title: Double date bingo
kfbe19.caption:
Two couples, two cards and one bowling lane. Shoes too big, a granny bowl, a couple name, and then one slip that made all four laugh.
Who is your double date couple?

kfbe20.title: Blackout: the date that just went right
kfbe20.caption:
No fireworks. Cocoa, a matched walking pace, a shared scarf, a quiet bench and one text home. Every square filled.
What small thing would fill your card?
